Spring of the Classic Year has ended, and 
the season for Summer Training Camp has 
arrived.

There's no use staying down in the dumps. 
Deciding that if she had to worry, she 
might as well worry with a smile, El 
Condor Pasa refreshed her mindset.

Bringing along her pet bird "Mambo," a 
bright and joyful summer had begun!
